parameters.query:
WITH new_company AS (
  INSERT INTO companies (name, sector, hq_country)
  VALUES ($1, $2, $3)
  RETURNING id
),
new_contact AS (
  INSERT INTO contacts (company_id, first_name, last_name, email, phone, is_primary)
  VALUES ((SELECT id FROM new_company), $4, $5, $6, $7, TRUE)
  RETURNING id
)
INSERT INTO deals (name, company_id, primary_contact_id, deal_type, sector, deal_size_usd, description, status, source, raw_payload)
VALUES ($8, (SELECT id FROM new_company), (SELECT id FROM new_contact), $9, $10, $11, $12, 'ingested', 'webhook', $13)
RETURNING id, name, status, deal_size_usd, created_at;
